question: What do the encoders' representations group the flaps by?

failed_criteria.statement: Best WavJEPA layer beats the MFCC baseline
failed_criteria.threshold: gap >= 0.05 balanced accuracy, and paired word-type bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0
failed_criteria.result: best layer 3: 0.5438; MFCC 0.5274; gap +0.0163 (needs >= 0.05); paired word-type bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0154, +0.0561] (lower bound needs > 0)

failed_criteria.statement: Minority-class F1 (/d/) at the best layer
failed_criteria.result: /d/ F1 at layer 3 0.3563 (needs >= 0.45; trivial floors 0.391 always-/d/, 0.327 coin, 0.243 base rate)

findings.statement: 25.1% of joint test sites (2,612) have their lemma in training with the same label; the split is disjoint by word form, not lemma. On the 7,586 lemma-unseen sites the gap to MFCC is +0.030, CI [-0.004, +0.073], still short of criterion 1.
The gap to MFCC's paired word-type bootstrap interval is [-0.015, +0.056]: no evidence of an advantage over MFCC, which is not evidence of none.

findings.cause: Sites aren't what the inventory says
findings.status: ruled out for the sites, not the labels
findings.statement: A blind listening audit of 80 sites heard a flap in 72 of 74 decidable cases (6 /d/ can't-tells), and the right word and a well-placed clip in all 80. The labels come from the dictionary form and can't be heard under a flap, so the audit clears the sites, not the labels.
Retraining the single-axis conditions at joint's training size (about 64% of sites) costs 0.006–0.013 at the best layer, against a 0.108 drop from random to joint.

findings.status: ruled out for MFCC; open for the encoders until the cropped design runs
findings.statement: Sites are 2–4 encoder frames wide (median 3, 27.4 ms). MFCC's 25 ms frames see only local audio (deltas reach ±40 ms), so for MFCC a cue outside the site's frames is invisible. WavJEPA and wav2vec2-base encode the flap ± 200 ms as one excerpt, so at depth their flap frames can carry that context; for WavJEPA the pilot shows only that the cue wasn't linearly recoverable from those frames. The span grid's pooled design (2026-10-29) widened the pooled frames to the preceding stretch, the following segment, or both, and no representation gained (largest +0.015, none called). For MFCC, whose frames are local, that rules width out, and the stretch's duration alone is near chance (about 0.53). For the encoders the pooled design cannot rule it out: every span's frames had heard the whole excerpt, so pooling more of them changes which frames are read, not what was heard. That test is the cropped design, deferred (span grid §8, 2026-10-29). Narrow frames don't explain WavJEPA's score on their own: from the same ɾ span, wav2vec2-base reaches 0.616 under joint, against WavJEPA's 0.543.
evidenced_by: Environment env-v-flap-v (status: used) - The preceding stretch through the following segment.

findings.cause: The cue doesn't generalize to unseen words
findings.statement: The drop from random to joint is mostly the word axis: holding out speakers costs little, holding out word types costs most of the gap above chance.

answer:
**The rows don't say directly what the encoders' representations group the flaps by.** None of them reports a clustering, similarity or grouping analysis. They report only probe accuracies and possible explanations for the failed criteria.

The closest evidence is indirect:

- **Word identity matters most.** The drop from random to joint splits comes mostly from the word axis. Holding out word types costs most of the gap above chance, while holding out speakers costs little [find-words]. This is "consistent with the result," not a finding that the representations are organised by word.
- **Lemma overlap is a registered limitation.** 25.1% of joint test sites share their lemma, with the same label, with training data [find-lemma].
- **Training size is ruled out** as the cause of the drop [find-training].
- **Context is still open for the encoders.** WavJEPA and wav2vec2-base encode the flap ± 200 ms, so their flap frames may carry surrounding context. Whether that matters remains open until the cropped design runs [find-width].
- **Encoders differ.** From the same span, wav2vec2-base reaches 0.616 under joint versus WavJEPA's 0.543 [find-width].
- **Labels are unverified.** They come from dictionary forms and can't be heard under a flap; the audit cleared the sites, not the labels [find-sites].

Answering the question would need an analysis of the representations themselves, such as clustering or probing them for word, speaker or context. No such analysis appears in these rows.
